SqlAuthenticationParameters.summary: Represents AD authentication parameters passed by a driver to authentication providers.

remarks.para: During federated authentication, SQL Server supplies the security token service URL (STSURL) and target resource identifier (SPN) in the FEDAUTHINFO token. The driver passes these values to the authentication provider or access-token callback as and , respectively.

These values reflect the server's authentication configuration. The driver does not impose a fixed list of authority or resource identifiers, allowing customer-configured authentication systems. Protocol checks and the selected authentication provider's requirements still apply.

ctor.summary: Construct with values for all properties.
ctor.param: The target resource identifier used to acquire an access token.
The authority URI used to acquire an access token.
The user login name/ID, or null if not applicable.
The user password, or null if not applicable.
The authentication timeout, in seconds. The overall connection timeout is managed by the driver; this timeout only applies to authentication.

Resource.summary: Gets the target resource identifier used to acquire an access token.
Resource.value: The target resource identifier. During federated authentication, the driver supplies the SPN value received from SQL Server in the FEDAUTHINFO token.

remarks.para: The FEDAUTH SPN identifies the resource for token acquisition. It is not the Kerberos service principal name configured by the Server SPN or Failover Partner SPN connection-string options, or an application's service-principal client ID.

The authentication provider or access-token callback uses this identifier according to its token acquisition requirements. For example, the Azure authentication provider appends /.default when the resource does not already have that scope suffix.

Authority.value: The authority URI. During federated authentication, the driver supplies the security token service URL (STSURL) received from SQL Server in the FEDAUTHINFO token.
Authority.remarks: The authentication provider or access-token callback uses this URI according to its token acquisition requirements. For example, the Azure authentication provider parses an absolute HTTPS URL into an authority host and tenant before acquiring a token.

UserId.value: The user login name/ID, or null if not applicable.

Password.value: The user password, or null if not applicable.

ConnectionTimeout.summary: Gets the authentication timeout value, in seconds.
